facts.fact: The World Bank says Mali's connection to the regional switch is inefficient, which limits public and private users of the payment system, while the Public Treasury is not yet connected to GIM-UEMOA.

MLI.note: The post says recourse for complaints is lacking and a framework is needed, but states no rule in force or draft.

facts.fact: The World Bank says Mali's connection to the regional switch is inefficient but limits users of the payment system, implying participation in GIM-UEMOA, with the Public Treasury not yet connected.

The World Bank says Mali is committed to supporting the vulnerable with social payments delivered through an account, and that the Jigisemeyiri Project gave cash transfers to 62,000 food-insecure households during the pandemic.

systems.owner: Government of Mali with World Bank

MLI.note: The post gives access to financial services at 44% in 2021 without naming a survey of adult account ownership, and 38% receiving a digital payment, below 79%.

facts.fact: The World Bank says Mali had 935 mobile money accounts per 1,000 adults in 2021, with mobile money rising from 21% to 65% of GDP between 2015 and 2021.

MLI.note: The post notes only the lack of a strategy to modernize revenue mobilization; no electronic payment is stated.
